decision: Accepted for actual pressure branch coverage and bounded protocol/latency diagnostics, with concrete reachability limitations. Existing frozen production source acceptance remains valid; no further production mutation or test requested.
evidence_scope: Independent source inspection and reading/reconciling existing author and runtime-gate receipts. Small file hashing/readback only; no replay, generator, or latency rerun by this reviewer.

checks.finding: Searches the real arena Nav grid. The self position is passable with at least 10 m wall distance. All targets are passable, in the same component, inside arena margin, at nav ground level, with a walk line and clear shot/sight rays. Nav defaults radius 2.5 m and height 9 m match the unchanged hello mech config.
checks.status: source accepted; helper-level geometry, not server engine proof

checks.finding: Actor IDs exclude self ID 3. Dense opponents use >=6 m center separation for radius 2.5 m. All 15 dense opponents are within 44 m (inside 45 m near vision); other contacts are within the 200 m vision range and in front. Weapon and mech stats clone the hello config; upgrades and cubes remain empty/zero.
checks.status: source accepted for schema/map counterfactual coverage; timer caveat below

checks.finding: 300 observations in nine scenes, tick 2000+2*i and t=100+0.1*i for the actual 20 Hz / decide-every-2 config. Safe current/next zone centers are at self, deliberately preventing zone-urgent bypass. Empty upgrade arrays do not invent unavailable stat bonuses. The armed deadline activates pressure after 90 s.
checks.status: source accepted for branch coverage; synthetic zone is not hello schedule

checks.finding: Checks passability and nav-level feet for every observed target plus pairwise opponent separation. Search construction already checks self-target separation for dense actors and minimum 25 m nominal range for singleton actors. The source does not run a full physics step or prove sequential reachability.

Wraps the actual B.pressure.legs closure on each created brain, increments entry before calling it exactly once, and increments returns only for a truthy result. The original function is not replaced with a fabricated return; no source/bundle is edited. Normal bundled runtime timing is collected separately.

Both candidates require active=300, zoneUrgent=0, pressureLegsReturns=300 and nonzero close/fire/seek branches; burst additionally requires cycle. Per-scene phases and final legKind are retained. Counters require zero internal errors/fuse events.

Two predetermined orders, three candidates, official and contact streams give 12 planned processes. Official acceptance parses timely/missed/late counts and rejects internal retries. Contact receipts have exactly 300 answered and zero late/schema/wrong-tick/bad-line/no-answer errors. All 12 raw results are retained.
checks.status: 12/12 accepted; existing evidence read, no rerun by this reviewer

limitations: The fixture is counterfactual protocol input, not a reactive simulation, server engine replay, or a claimed feasible complete match history. Actions do not advance the subsequent supplied observations.
The synthetic zone center/radius/times differ from the hello zone phase schedule. This is intentional branch isolation, not proof that the exact zone exists at t=100 in the official engine.

The nearby_pickup scene supplies laser cooldown 3 seconds while the copied base laser stat is 1.65 seconds. This is schema-valid blocked-weapon stress input, not a proved engine-reachable timer state.
Geometry validity is checked with the repository World/Nav implementation and official arena data. It does not independently prove the authoritative engine collision or movement semantics.
The borrowed end message place=13, kills=0 is protocol termination only and has no score/evaluation meaning for this fixture.
Original burst official checker results remain 298/300 in time, 2 late, max 243.3 ms. The later predetermined 12-process diagnostic is clean but does not erase or explain those outliers.
The warmup source gap remains documented: normal 800-decision rehearsal reaches at most 79.9 s per fresh brain and does not activate pressure. No active-warmup change was promoted.
No official placement improvement, 7.5 score, hard real-time guarantee, or Docker/cgroup equivalence follows from these checks.
